bio: This restaurant, which occupies an old fisherman’s house, serves a fusion of Catalan cuisine combined with the flavours of Peru, the chef’s homeland, all showcased on an à la carte plus three set menus (Seasonal; Tasting; and Entre dos Mons). The restaurant has its own vegetable garden, buys its fish daily from the Palamós fish auction and maintains a strong commitment to sustainability. The wine served here is sourced from small-scale producers, so it’s worth asking the owner to introduce you to some of these oenological gems!...
